G54's census rules for R02, written before the census runs; not an amendment. (1) A line shows R02 when it has a tag row: SHOW and P-G6 (PO) instantiate rows, S-SHOW restrict and add-condition rows, and REJ absent rows; NOT rows and evidence limits do not. (2) A room shows R02 when one of its lines does. The census counts rooms showing R02 among the rooms with R02 lines; rooms by form (CA carrying or reporting, NA naming or calling for the role, CO a seat in a shared council or chat) and by number of forms; rooms by side (OE, the room's own member acts; VE-only, only a visitor acts for its own room); AC-only rooms; and rooms whose only showing lines are PO particulars. (3) The status ruling weighs the rooms where the room's own member acts (OE) against the cost the C5a-02 cut named: 13 rooms, and a model that can no longer name the role while P08 still holds deals settled through envoys. If OE rooms are many times 13 and spread across the forms, the population's evidence supports re-admitting R02 as standing with its statement unchanged, since no restrict or add-condition line was a correction (QD3-002; the P06 precedent of move 177). If OE rooms are near 13, R02 stays a candidate. VE-only rooms show the role under G18 in the visitor's own room's record, so they count toward rooms showing R02 but not toward the OE share. (4) No count chooses the wording: the statement and range stay as written unless a correction is met twice, and none was. Next: d3_r02_census.py
